name: not-so-boring-news
description: Check how well a news story is sourced and create a shareable infographic.

interface.longDescription: Check the sources behind a news article or public news topic. Not So Boring News returns a reliability score, claim-level evidence, a plain-language summary, and one shareable infographic. It is a source verifier, not a final verdict on truth.
defaultPrompt: Check the sources behind this article: [paste URL]
Check recent coverage of [news topic] and make an infographic.
Show me whether this news story is well sourced: [paste URL]

positive.description: Resolve a recent typed award topic, check the selected article, and show the final visual result using the default infographic style.
positive.prompt: Check recent coverage of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay and make an infographic.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the October 2026 Nobel announcement and strong public coverage, start the check with the default infographic style, poll until complete, then show a scored source report, infographic, cited sources, and full-report link.

positive.description: Check a typed Canadian labour-market topic and render the Digital Zine result.
positive.prompt: Check Canada's September 2026 jobs report and use the Digital Zine style.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the September 2026 Statistics Canada release, return the sourcing score and caveats, and display a readable infographic with a full-report link.

positive.description: Check a typed science-award topic and render the Modern Editorial result.
positive.prompt: Check the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology for optogenetics and use the Modern Editorial style.
positive.expected_behavior: Use relevant public coverage, distinguish supported and approximate claims, and display the completed infographic and report link.

positive.description: Check a supplied long-form article URL.
positive.prompt: Check this article and make a Neo-Minimalist infographic: https://asteriskmag.com/issues/15/so-you-think-you-could-be-an-electrician
positive.expected_behavior: Check six material claims from the supplied article, report source quality and caveats, and display the completed infographic and full-report link.

positive.description: Check a supplied music-business article URL.
positive.prompt: Check this article and make a Modern Editorial infographic: https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/umg-is-now-managing-130-artists-in-southeast-asia-says-adam-granite-who-wants-a-future-that-isnt-filled-with-slop/
positive.expected_behavior: Check the article's material claims against the tiered source list, then display a scored result, infographic, cited sources, and full-report link.

negative.description: Do not invoke the source verifier for an unrelated creative-writing request.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about reading the Sunday newspaper.

negative.description: Do not imply that the plugin can publish to a social network.
negative.prompt: Publish my infographic to Instagram now.

negative.description: Ask for usable input when no article link or identifiable public news topic is provided.
negative.prompt: Verify the private rumor I heard, but I will not share the claim or a link.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with article and typed-topic source checks, three infographic styles, reliability scoring, full-report links, and the official Not So Boring News branding.
